checks.message: Provisional rough boundary is explicitly disclosed and not represented as official.
All three key areas are present and explicitly provisional.
A single cut grid partitions the full submitted boundary without area gaps or overlaps.
Participant-controlled polygon layers are clipped to the submitted provisional site boundary.
Known spatial metrics are recomputed in EPSG:4548; statutory controls remain unknown.
12 scenario cards, 3 industry tests, 5 personas and 3 landmarks are provided with human-review boundaries.
Offline static HTML contains no remote resource, script, iframe, form, API call or tracking code.
The report cites sources, standards, depth items, geometry and every known metric.
All diagrams are generated from repository data and original vector composition; no third-party imagery is embedded.
Planning approval, engineering feasibility, privacy-impacting deployment and public-space operation remain subject to human review.
